कोक

KOKA . (Cakravāka bird). Ruddy Goose. To know the Purāṇic story about the origin of this bird (Ruddy goose) see under ‘Arayanna’ (Swan).

कोकामुख

KOKĀMUKHA . A holy place. It is mentioned in mahābhārata, Vana Parva, Chapter 84, Stanza 153, that those who bathe in this holy bath will get the faculty of remembering their previous births.

कोकनद १

KOKANADA I . A kṣatriya King of ancient india. It is mentioned in mahābhārata, Sabhā Parva, that at the time of the regional conquest of arjuna, this King fell at his feet and sought refuge.

कोकनद २

KOKANADA II . A warrior of skanda. (M.B. Sabhā Parva, Chapter 27).

कोकवक

KOKAVAKA . A country in ancient india. (M.B. bhīṣma parva, Chapter 9).

कोकिलक

KOKILAKA . A warrior of skanda. (mahābhārata, śalya Parva, Chapter 45, Stanza 73).
